sourceTemplate.access: read-only source; edited only in a new private copy for this opportunity

inspection.method: Rebuilt from the approved Google Docs export with every list marker normalized to one point below its item text; rasterized every page at 110 DPI, visually inspected all pages, compared final rasters with the pre-rebuild inspection set, and checked PDF geometry, text, and link annotations.

pages.notes: Target title, contact links, resident-facing product profile, lifecycle and delivery skills, and Thick Arts evidence are legible with clear hierarchy and no clipping, overlap, or broken glyphs.

WOW List, CallNYC, KC Town Hall, resident-service evidence, additional leadership, education, and work authorization are legible; Politico New York is visibly blue and underlined and links to the archived article PDF.

boundary: Artifact and visual-quality inspection only. No named hiring reader participated, and a pass is not an endorsement, interview promise, eligibility determination, or hiring decision.
